text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has come once again,<n>but Symboli
Rudolf seems far more<n>relaxed this time around.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's perfectly content to watch the<n>curtain rise
on the camp as nothing<n>more than another student
of Tracen<n>Academy.
